name: MonarchAiAttachmentTray
title: AiAttachmentTray
wrapsNative: ScrollView(.horizontal) of MonarchAttachmentChip (MonarchFileTypeIcon, ProgressView with .progressViewStyle(.monarchLinear), retry and remove Buttons)
summary: The files attached to a message for an assistant, in a row that wraps onto new rows, each with its type, name and size, upload progress, failure and retry, and a remove button.
whenToUse: Above the prompt field of an assistant's composer, for the files the person attached before sending.
whenNotToUse: For files already sent in a message, show MonarchAttachmentChip or a file card in the message. For a long upload list, use MonarchUploadQueue.
api: init(_ files: [MonarchAiAttachmentTrayFile], labels: MonarchAiAttachmentTrayLabels = MonarchAiAttachmentTrayLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, onRemove: @escaping @MainActor (String) -> Void)

struct MonarchAiAttachmentTrayFile { init(id: String, name: String, size: Int64? = nil, contentType: String? = nil, progress: Double? = nil, isFailed: Bool = false, errorMessage: String? = nil); init(_ part: MonarchAiFilePart, id: String? = nil, progress: Double? = nil) }

struct MonarchAiAttachmentTrayLabels { init(label: String? = nil, ready: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil, removed: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil, chip: MonarchAttachmentChipLabels = MonarchAttachmentChipLabels()) }

options.name: files
options.description: The attached files in the order they were added: name, size, MIME type, progress, and failure (isFailed or an errorMessage). A conversation's MonarchAiFilePart converts with init(_:id:progress:).

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the tray's name, the uploaded and removed announcements, and each chip's strings.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Retries a failed upload by file id. Without it failed files have no retry button.

options.name: onRemove
options.description: Removes a file by id; take it out of files.

states.name: uploading
states.description: The percentage under the name and a linear progress bar.

states.name: failed
states.description: The error message (or "Upload failed") in the danger colour, with a retry button when onRetry is set.

appearance: A row of MonarchAttachmentChip tiles on the muted control fill with a default border, each at most about 240 points wide before Dynamic Type, wrapping onto new rows. All colours are theme roles, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web shows an image thumbnail for picture files; MonarchAttachmentChip has no thumbnail slot yet, so iOS shows the file type icon for every file. The web moves keyboard focus to the next remove button after a removal; on iOS the removal is announced and VoiceOver focus is left to the system. The web's progress and error fields are a number and a string or true; on iOS they are progress, isFailed and errorMessage. Android has the same parameters.
accessibility: The tray is a container named "Attachments".
Each file's name is one element whose value is its size, percentage or failure; the type icon is decorative.
The progress bar is a standard ProgressView named "Uploading" and the file name.
Retry and remove are buttons named with the file name, with 44-point touch targets.
A finished upload ("photo.png uploaded") and a file removed with its button ("photo.png removed") are announced; a failure is announced by the chip.
edgeCases: Long names are shortened in the middle, so the extension stays visible.
A progress outside 0 through 1 is clamped; a progress of 1 counts as ready.
Several changes in one update are announced together.
